title: Creamy mushroom pasta
description: Rich, silky and comforting pasta dinner.
instructions: Cook the pasta. Fry sliced mushrooms in olive oil, add oat cream and simmer. Toss with the pasta.

title: Fresh chickpea salad
description: A light salad with crunchy vegetables and bright lemon.
instructions: Drain canned chickpeas. Dice cucumber and tomato. Toss with lemon juice and olive oil.

title: Creamy chicken rice
description: A hearty chicken dinner with a rich cream sauce.
instructions: Cook the rice. Pan-fry diced chicken until cooked through, add cream and simmer. Serve over rice.

title: Coconut chickpea curry
description: A warming, creamy and gently spicy curry.
instructions: Fry chopped onion with curry powder. Add canned chickpeas and coconut milk. Simmer and stir in spinach.

title: Smoky black bean tacos
description: Smoky beans with crisp cabbage and lime.
instructions: Warm canned beans with smoked paprika. Fill warm tortillas and top with shredded cabbage and lime.

title: Lemon herb couscous
description: A fluffy, tangy side with fresh parsley.
instructions: Prepare couscous according to the package. Fluff and mix with lemon, chopped parsley and oil.

title: Tomato lentil stew
description: A hearty tomato stew with earthy lentils.
instructions: Soften diced onion and carrot. Add canned tomatoes and rinsed red lentils with water and simmer until tender.

title: Ginger tofu stir-fry
description: A bright, savory dinner with crisp broccoli.
instructions: Brown cubed tofu in oil. Stir-fry broccoli and ginger, then return tofu and add soy sauce.

title: Apple cinnamon oats
description: Warm, soft breakfast oats with sweet apple.
instructions: Simmer oats in water with diced apple and cinnamon until soft.

title: Roasted cauliflower bowls
description: Nutty roasted cauliflower with fluffy quinoa.
instructions: Roast cauliflower in olive oil at 220°C until tender. Cook quinoa and serve with tahini and lemon.

title: Peanut cucumber noodles
description: Cold, tangy noodles with crisp cucumber.
instructions: Cook and cool wheat noodles. Whisk peanut butter, lime and soy sauce with water. Toss with cucumber.

title: Salmon and dill potatoes
description: A light, herby dinner with flaky salmon.
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Bake salmon until cooked through and serve with dill and lemon.
